## Fourth Global Coral Bleaching Event Set a Record for Heat-Stress Exposure

The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. Satellite data measured bleaching-level heat stress across roughly 84.4% of the world’s reef area from January 2023 through September 2025—a separate measure covering a period that began before the event’s confirmation.

The recorded footprint exceeded the 68.2% of global reef area affected by bleaching-level heat stress during the 2014–2017 event. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories.

The record concerns the area exposed to bleaching-level heat stress. It does not establish that every exposed reef bleached or died.
